_doc: Curation source for the project archive. Folder = ../Graphics/VISENI/01 - Selección Proyectos/<folder>. hero: best, most representative image (hero, listing card, OG). pause: full-bleed panoramic further down the page. exclude: duplicates, AI variants and frames not to publish. Order = listing order. Run: python3 scripts/media/build_projects.py; optionally --projects ID [ID ...] to rebuild selected projects.

projects.why: Sea horizon, long white planes and timber: the line the text describes; aerial explains the hillside
Dusk with La Concha behind: the studio's signature image. Garage frame excluded (visible number plates)
Warm interior glow under the horizontal slabs at dusk; dusk aerial shows the setting
Retouched frontal at golden hour with La Concha; the pond view is the garden the text is about. Unretouched duplicate excluded
Twilight, lit porches and pool: the evening the text closes with; zenithal aerial reads the plan
Pink dusk sky over the cantilevered volumes, light revealing geometry
Sunset over the pool and pergolas: the shadow geometry at its warmest
Dramatic dusk, stone and gables floating over the hillside
Planes and levels stepping down to the sunken lounge at dusk
Frontal villa over its infinity pool among planting; aerial over the coast gives the territorial reading
Terraced villa among bougainvillea; aerial shows the shared identity facing the sea
Calm stone-and-glass pavilion over the pool; aerial explains the slope
Dusk, symmetrical garden front and lit pools: proportion and outdoor life
Full rhythm of arches across the garden front. AI variants excluded
Water as a horizon line at blue hour; mountain view from the terrace
Violet dusk, the water front as an architectural gesture
Long dusk elevation: the geometry with presence
Garden at the centre, low pavilions lit under a dramatic sky
Only frame without watermark; bright day view, the 'claridad de día'

The volume under warm light, as the headline says

Complete view of the white volumes, pergolas and pool
